sourceIndex.meaning: Static navigation snapshot of tracked paths and candidate C# members, with owner-level links to logical-table review records. Links do not certify whole-file coverage or freshness. Every path still requires classification; no-hit files and inactive preprocessor regions need inspection. Refresh after source or inventory changes.

rules: Nonsense means arbitrary authored data with no supported mathematical or functional basis; a switch or fitted expression that merely recites arbitrary values is not a meaningful port. Genuine named dispatch/case selection remains permitted.
Only entries explicitly marked converted or retained have a disposition under this ticket.
Historical XML formulas and closed research issues are inputs, not reviewed dispositions.
Owner candidates must be split into separately indexed logical fields; aliases share one entry.

User-authorized switch/case conversion is valid when a table clearly represents fixed case selection or dispatch; preserve domain, compatibility exceptions and one independent proof per logical table.
Discover through source and call graphs only. Do not run research suites or gameplay to choose work.
No repository-wide completion claim: unlisted tables are unreviewed, not excluded.
Retain a lookup only if porting is impossible or would produce nonsense. Performance, complexity, table size and unknown historical-tool provenance are not retention reasons.

tables.domain: ushort health 0..6000; native eight unsigned little-endian thresholds selected by even byte offsets 0..14
tables.interpretation: First nonnegative signed 16-bit health-minus-threshold difference. Differences cannot overflow in supported health range. Adjacent $FFFF at $A5:96FF is unreachable.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read all eight bank_A5.asm thresholds and CMP/BPL loop; complete production selector compared with original cartridge threshold scan for all 6001 health inputs.
tables.disposition: Remove threshold array and search; return 2*max(0,7-health/750) after preserving maximum-health validation.
tables.rationale: Uniform integer differences of 750 explain every threshold. Integer quotient directly expresses health bands; no floating point, fitting, interpolation or exceptional corrections needed. Exact multiples belong to higher band.
tables.proofTest: VerifyDraygonHealthPaletteDefinitions (existing test reused; installed color fixture supplied)

tables.domain: even ushort phase byte offsets 0..14 and all ushort health values 0..65535
tables.interpretation: Threshold words are unsigned little-endian. Subtraction wraps to 16 bits then tests sign. Offset 16 is caller-owned completion; odd or later offsets are rejected.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read all eight bank_B3.asm thresholds and CMP/BPL/completion flow; complete production result compared with original cartridge thresholds for all 524288 phase/health pairs.
tables.disposition: Remove threshold array; compute 375*(8-phaseByteOffset/2) after offset validation and retain signed wrapped subtraction.
tables.rationale: Uniform integer differences of 375 exactly explain the threshold domain. A direct unsigned health comparison would change supported wrap behavior; formula changes only the selected threshold.
tables.proofTest: VerifyBotwoonHealthPaletteDefinitions (existing test reused; installed color fixture supplied)

tables.nativeIdentity: $A8:CCC9+10*i timer field of palette records; $A8:CC67 graphics hook
tables.domain: ushort byte offsets 0,10,20,30,40,50; normalization additionally accepts terminator offset 60
tables.interpretation: Six unsigned little-endian duration words interleaved with four color words. Native cursor advances ten bytes. Negative color word at $A8:CCFD resets cursor before reading the next timer.
tables.reviewedEvidence: Read all six bank_A8.asm records and native timer/advance/reset flow; compare every production duration to cartridge, verify terminator, rejected offsets and 193-call production cadence.
tables.disposition: Remove duration array; return record%3==0 ? 64 : 16 after existing alignment/range validation.
tables.rationale: Two exact repetitions of a three-record timing policy. Bounded modulo clearly names cadence and does not admit invalid inputs. Colors are separately owned presentation data, not covered by this disposition.
tables.proofTest: VerifyWorkRobotPaletteTimingDefinitions (existing test reused; duration rejection assertions extended)

velocity.algorithm: Eastern action selects packed FF50 (-176/256 pixel per frame); central and western actions select FF20 (-224/256). These are NTSC action operands, not the different PAL regional operands. Existing FX owner sign-extends then shifts eight bits into its 16.16 accumulator.
velocity.proof: VerifySpeedEscapeStageVelocities compares all three original packed operands and complete selector ownership.

motherBrainGlassPlmProgramReview.source: NTSC J/U v1.0 84:D202..D2F8; pinned bank_84.asm 362be646929cf8e483f692b73a6561cfc2dc1d0d. Read RoomPlmProgramDefinitions composition and RoomPlmSystem.MotherBrainGlass consumers. ROM resolves misplaced native comment annotations around timed draws. Shard parameter meaning independently confirmed against bank_86.asm CE61..CE6C and the production initializer: X offsets +8/-40/-16, constant Y +32.

controls.algorithm: Nine damage stages, ten bytes for simple threshold waits and 34 bytes for paired shard transitions; final stage adds a 48-tick hold, event and deletion. Every stage starts with a one-tick draw. Burst transitions use four-tick intermediate holds. Preamble checks boss/event and installs the hit callback; two terminal branches retain one-tick draw/deletion.
controls.proof: VerifyGlassControls compares all 86 native opcode/duration bytes.

draws.algorithm: Named glass damage/pane/shatter cases follow stage index; burst transitions and final hold select the next stage. Boss-dead selects cleared glass; persisted destruction selects final shatter.
draws.proof: VerifyGlassDraws compares all seventeen native draw operands.

targets.algorithm: Each threshold loop returns to its calculated stage start. Named boss-dead and no-glass branches preserve alternate entry points.
targets.proof: VerifyGlassTargets compares eleven native branch operands.

callback.algorithm: Named D1E6 missile-hit callback shared with the runtime comparison.

events.algorithm: Both accesses use the named MotherBrainGlassDestroyed event.

bossMask.algorithm: Single packed primary-area-boss bit at D204; preserves alignment change for every subsequent word.

thresholds.algorithm: Nine stages require 2*(stage+1) hits, from two through eighteen; the opcode loops while the room argument is below that threshold.
thresholds.proof: VerifyGlassThresholds compares all nine native operands.

shardArguments.algorithm: Semantic emitter selections for five paired bursts. First pair uses right only, second left only; next uses right/right/left/left then centre only; final two pairs use left/left/centre/centre. Positions are named and represent the glass portions removed by the adjacent draw transitions.
shardArguments.proof: VerifyGlassShardArguments compares all forty original argument words.

motherBrainGlassPlmProgramReview.domain: 247 bytes and 246 overlapping word starts. Each focused proof checks full ushort byte/word ownership and rejected zero values plus its original field through both direct and composed readers, including mixed-field and odd overlaps. A word at D2F8 remains rejected, and callback machine code D2F9 onward is outside the domain. No cache or gameplay ROM read.
